services.title: Precision Rotary Root Canal Therapy
services.description: Conservative rotary root canal treatment designed to eliminate deep nerve infection and stop pain while preserving your natural tooth root.
services.idealFor: Deep cavities, nerve infection, severe chewing ache

services.title: Aesthetic Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns
services.description: Custom-milled zirconia and ceramic dental crowns providing high fracture resistance, lifelike translucency, and full chewing reinforcement.
services.idealFor: Post-root canal teeth, cracked enamel, missing tooth gaps

services.title: Ultrasonic Scaling & Teeth Polishing
services.description: Professional ultrasonic cleaning that gently removes stubborn tartar, plaque, and stains from tooth surfaces and below gum margins.
services.idealFor: Plaque accumulation, bleeding gums, tea/coffee stains, routine care

services.title: Tooth-Colored Composite Fillings
services.description: Aesthetic tooth-colored resin restorations that bond seamlessly to natural tooth structure, preventing recurring decay and restoring bite shape.
services.idealFor: Cavities, chipped tooth edges, minor tooth wear

services.title: Gentle Atraumatic Tooth Extractions
services.description: Gentle tooth extractions performed with precision micro-instruments under targeted local anesthesia to protect bone and ensure quick recovery.

services.title: Custom Precision Partial Dentures
services.description: Custom-designed partial acrylic and flexible dentures engineered for snug suction and chewing stability without causing gum irritation.
